PAD_LEVELS.title: First grooves
PAD_LEVELS.summary: Kick, snare and eighth hats, split hands.

PAD_LEVELS.title: Boom bap and the first breaks
PAD_LEVELS.summary: Two-bar hip-hop beats with the kick moving.

PAD_LEVELS.title: Ghost notes
PAD_LEVELS.summary: Soft snares between the backbeats; sixteenth hats.

PAD_LEVELS.title: Independence, fills and swing
PAD_LEVELS.summary: Hats steady while the kick changes; fills; MPC swing.

PAD_LEVELS.title: Dance and trap
PAD_LEVELS.summary: House, trap rolls, drum and bass.

PAD_LEVELS.title: The breaks
PAD_LEVELS.summary: The Amen and Apache breaks, bar by bar.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index on kick, right index on snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The backbeat with eighth hats over it.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The beat under a thousand songs (Billie Jean sits on it at about 117).
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The kick's second hit lands on the & of 2: the first push.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: A kick on every beat, the clap on 2 and 4.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index on the kick, right index on the clap.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: A kick off the beat.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Two bars; the second answers the first.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The generic hip-hop kick: four hits after the backbeat on 2.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Two kicks together on the & of 2 and 3; an open hat after.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Slow and heavy; the kick on the a of 2 is the surprise.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Sixteenth hats, ghosted snares around the backbeats, open hats on the a of 2 and 4.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle alternate the hats; left index the snare and its ghosts, left middle the kick.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Four on the floor with the snare on the a of 1, the & of 2, and again.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index on the kick, right index on the snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Ghosts on the a of 2, the e of 3 and the a of 4: soft, under 40% of the backbeat.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The "Yeah! Woo!" break: one kick, the snare on 2 and 4 with ghosts on the a of 2 and the & of 3, and sixteenths (a tambourine on the record) a little behind the beat.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle alternate the sixteenths on the hats; left index the snare and ghosts, left middle the kick.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Sixteenth hats over a kick on 1, the a of 1 and the & of 3; ghosts on the a of 2 and the a of 4.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle alternate the sixteenths on the hats; left index the snare and ghosts, left middle the kick.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The hats never change; the kick takes a new pattern every bar.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Three bars of rock, then four sixteenth snares on beat 4 and back to 1.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Fill: alternate both index fingers on the snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Sixteenths down the kit: snare, high, mid and low tom, then the downbeat.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Alternate hands, right leading, across the pads from left to right.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Three bars and a fill that turns the phrase around.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Every second sixteenth a little late: loose, not yet a shuffle.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle alternate the hats, the middle a touch late.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Nearer the triplet: the hip-hop lilt.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle alternate the hats; feel the late one, don't count it.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Swung hats over a straight kick, and the snare pushed about 20 ms early: two feels at once.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Closed hat on the beat, open hat on every &; the kick never stops.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index on the kick, left middle the clap, right index and middle the two hats.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Half time: the clap on 3. The last beat of hats rolls in thirty-seconds.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: The roll: right index and middle as a two-finger roll on one pad (or hold Note Repeat at 1/32).

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The same beat, the roll in sixteenth triplets (1/16T).
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Two-finger roll, six to the beat.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Kick on 1 and the & of 3, snare on 2 and 4, fast.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Kick on 1 with pushes on the & of 2 and 3; the rim answers on the a of 1 and the & of 2 (the 3-3-2), a clap on 2 and 4, shaker sixteenths. One common version: producers vary it.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand the shaker (hats) sixteenths; left index kick, left middle rim; the clap and conga (high tom) where they fall.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Four bars: the third delays the last snare, the fourth rearranges everything and crashes.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index on the ride; left index the snare and ghosts, left middle the kick.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Fela's drummer: kicks in pairs, a snare line of its own, the hand on the hats and the foot on the pedal hat all independent. Tempo approximate.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle the hats, left index the snare, left middle the kick, left ring the pedal hat. Learn it in Wait mode first.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The snare answers itself on the & of 3 and the a of 4 (tempo approximate).
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The dembow: a kick on every beat, the snare's 3+3+2 over it, a deep tom on 1 and 3.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index the kick, right index the snare, left middle the tom, right middle the hat.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The 3+3+2 split between kick (1 and the a of 1, 3 and the a of 3) and snare (the & of 2 and 4).
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand on the hats (index and middle alternating); left index on kick and snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: A kick on every beat under the cross-stick on 3: the marching reggae beat.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index the kick, left middle the rim, right hand the hats.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The guacharaca on the hats (one on the beat, two on the & and a), the llamador on 2 and 4. Players put the kick on every beat, on 2 and 4, or a tumbao: this one keeps it on the beat.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle the guacharaca; left index kick, left middle rim.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Nothing on 1: kick and cross-stick drop together on 3 of a half-time bar, an open hat leading into the next. Often played with a shuffle.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index the kick, left middle the rim, right hand the hats.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: "Tum pa-pá pum pá": a tresillo of drum skins (1, the a of 1, the & of 2) answered on 3 and 4, no hats, no snare. DJ Luciano Oliveira's own reduction.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index the kick and rack tom, right index and middle the conga (high tom), left middle the floor tom.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The surdo on the kick (soft pushes before 1 and 3), and the bossa clave on the cross-stick over two bars.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand the hats; left index the kick, left middle the rim; the pedal hat with a spare finger on 2 and 4.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Four on the floor with the 3+3+2 snare and an open hat sizzling on every &. (Teachers vary the hats: this is Boston Drum Lessons' version.)
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle the hats, opening on the &; left index kick, left middle snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Sixteenth hats, loud and soft; the tibwa's cinquillo on the rim; snare only on 2 and 4.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index and middle the hats (index loud, middle soft); left index kick, left middle snare, left ring rim.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The cowbell is the metronome of kompa, the gong (a muffled floor tom) on 4. Provisional: one band player's notation; tempo not documented.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index the cowbell, right middle the hats; left index the floor tom.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The tamborzão sped up to 150 (2016 on), with DJ Sany Pitbull's extra kick on the & of 3.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: As the tamborzão, lighter on the fingers.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The surdo on the kick (the first and last sixteenth of each beat), a busy hat line and the pedal hat on every &. Tempo approximate.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index and middle the kick figure, right hand the hats, left ring the pedal hat.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Three then two: the rhythm Cuban music, salsa and the Bo Diddley beat hang on.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index on the rim; count the sixteenths quietly.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: The son clave with its third note a sixteenth later: the rumba's lean.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index on the rim.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Two stomps and a clap, the oldest crowd rhythm there is.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index on the kick, right index on the clap.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Three-three-two in the kick against the snare on 2 and 4: the root of reggaeton, New Orleans and much of pop.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Left index on the kick, right index on the snare.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: RLRR LRLL with the right hand on the snare and the left on the hats: a sticking that sounds like a groove.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index on the snare, left index on the hats.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: A bar of groove, four sixteenths on the snare in its last beat, then crash and kick together on the one.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand hats and the fill, left index kick; land the crash with the right.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Shave and a haircut, two bits: the vaudeville ending (Charles Hale, 1899) every drummer plays to close a tune.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right hand across snare and toms, left index the kick under the last crash.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Hat, snare, kick, one at a time in threes over a four-beat bar: no two hits together.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Right index hats, right middle snare, left index kick.

PAD_REPERTOIRE.feel: Quarters, then eighths, then two bars of sixteenths over four on the floor, and the crash on the drop.
PAD_REPERTOIRE.fingers: Alternate right index and middle on the snare; left index keeps the kick.
